about: Single-color line and silhouette pieces for the church year, bundled with OpenBulletin. Every piece was verified at its source page on the retrieval date: the page states the license shown, and each piece was rendered and eyeballed before it shipped. All pieces are public domain or CC0, so no credit is owed; the records are kept anyway, because provenance is a habit, not a tax.
common_edits: Editor metadata, comments, and namespaces stripped; root reduced to xmlns + viewBox; explicit width/height removed.

sourcing_note: The plan was Openclipart/FreeSVG direct (docs/research/clipart-landscape.md). From this build machine, Openclipart's downloads timed out repeatedly and FreeSVG's download endpoint returned empty (bot-gated), so the same public-domain corpus was taken from Wikimedia Commons file pages, which state each file's license and author in machine-readable metadata; several pieces are Openclipart works carried there. Anything not clearly public domain or CC0 on its page was left out.
